id.question: Bagaimana Cara mengajukan Perizinan Berusaha KP3A PMSE?
id.answer: Melalui OSS dengan memilih kegiatan usaha yang sesuai, melengkapi data perusahaan, memenuhi persyaratan dasar dan persyaratan sektor terkait PMSE, kemudian mengajukan perizinan berusaha sesuai tingkat risiko.

id.question: Bagaimana Cara menerbitkan Izin KP3A?
id.answer: Pelaku usaha mengisi data pada OSS, memilih KBLI yang sesuai, melengkapi persyaratan dan memperoleh perizinan setelah seluruh persyaratan terpenuhi.

id.question: Apakah UD (Usaha Dagang) bisa daftar OSS dan menerbitkan NIB?
id.answer: Bisa. Usaha Dagang dapat mendaftar OSS sebagai usaha perseorangan dan memperoleh NIB.

id.question: Bagaimana cara mengajukan kemitraan bagi UMKM?
id.answer: Pengajuan dilakukan melalui fitur kemitraan pada OSS dengan melengkapi data usaha dan rencana kemitraan. Pelaku usaha mengakses menu kemitraan pada OSS, mengisi profil kemitraan, dan menyampaikan data yang diminta oleh sistem.

id.question: Apa saja KBLI yang diwajibkan bermitra dengan UMKM?
id.answer: KBLI yang wajib bermitra mengikuti ketentuan sektor usaha dan daftar bidang usaha yang mensyaratkan kemitraan sesuai peraturan investasi yang berlaku.

id.question: Apa itu Masterlist dalam sistem OSS?
id.answer: Masterlist merupakan fasilitas pencatatan impor mesin, barang dan bahan yang digunakan untuk memperoleh fasilitas kepabeanan tertentu sesuai ketentuan.

id.question: Bagaimana Cara pengajuan Fasilitas Impor bagi perseorangan?
id.answer: Permohonan diajukan melalui OSS dengan melengkapi data investasi dan kebutuhan impor sesuai persyaratan yang berlaku.

id.question: Bagaimana cara pengajuan fasilitas impor bahan baku?
id.answer: Pelaku usaha mengajukan fasilitas melalui OSS dengan memasukkan kebutuhan bahan baku dan dokumen pendukung yang dipersyaratkan.

id.question: Bagaimana cara mengajukan Tax Holiday?
id.answer: Permohonan diajukan melalui OSS dengan memenuhi kriteria industri pionir dan persyaratan investasi sesuai ketentuan Kementerian Keuangan.

id.question: Bagaimana cara mengajukan Investment Allowance?
id.answer: Permohonan dilakukan melalui OSS dengan melengkapi data investasi dan persyaratan yang ditentukan untuk memperoleh fasilitas tersebut.

id.question: Bagaimana cara mengajukan Tax Allowance?
id.answer: Pelaku usaha mengajukan permohonan melalui OSS dan memenuhi persyaratan bidang usaha serta nilai investasi yang ditentukan.

id.question: Apakah semua perizinan berusaha butuh PB-UMKU?
id.answer: Tidak. PB-UMKU hanya diperlukan untuk kegiatan usaha atau sektor tertentu yang mensyaratkannya.

id.question: Bagaimana Cara Pembuatan PETA Polygon?
id.answer: Peta polygon dibuat dengan menggambar titik koordinat lokasi usaha pada peta digital sesuai batas area kegiatan usaha.

id.question: Bagaimana cara perpanjangan PKKPR PSN/Penilaian?
id.answer: Permohonan perpanjangan diajukan melalui OSS sebelum masa berlaku berakhir dengan melengkapi dokumen yang dipersyaratkan.

id.question: Bagaimana cara perpanjangan PKKPR 181?
id.answer: Pelaku usaha mengajukan perpanjangan melalui OSS sesuai ketentuan Pasal 181 dengan melampirkan dokumen pendukung yang diperlukan.

id.question: Apa saja persetujuan lingkungan yang dimiliki oleh pelaku usaha untuk menjalankan kegiatan usahanya?
id.answer: Persetujuan lingkungan dapat berupa AMDAL, UKL-UPL, atau SPPL sesuai tingkat risiko dan dampak kegiatan usaha.

id.question: Apa yang dimaksud dengan PBG dan SLF? Dan bagaimana cara mengajukannya?
id.answer: PBG adalah Persetujuan Bangunan Gedung dan SLF adalah Sertifikat Laik Fungsi. Pengajuannya dilakukan melalui sistem SIMBG yang terintegrasi dengan OSS.

id.question: Berapa lama masa berlaku PKKPR?
id.answer: Masa berlaku PKKPR mengikuti ketentuan peraturan yang berlaku dan dapat berbeda tergantung jenis serta karakteristik kegiatan usaha.

id.question: Apa saja Kriteria untuk mengajukan PKKPR pasal 181?
id.answer: Kriteria mengikuti ketentuan Pasal 181 dan umumnya berlaku bagi kegiatan usaha yang telah memiliki dasar penguasaan tanah atau kondisi tertentu yang diatur peraturan.

id.question: Bagaimana cara mendapatkan KKPR untuk pelaku usaha UMK?
id.answer: UMK dapat memperoleh KKPR melalui OSS dengan mengisi data lokasi usaha dan mengikuti proses konfirmasi tata ruang yang tersedia dalam sistem.

id.question: Apa Pengertian dari KKPR?
id.answer: KKPR adalah Kesesuaian Kegiatan Pemanfaatan Ruang yang menyatakan kesesuaian rencana kegiatan usaha dengan tata ruang.

id.question: Apa yang termasuk Nilai Investasi Mesin?
id.answer: Nilai investasi mesin meliputi harga perolehan mesin dan peralatan yang digunakan secara langsung dalam kegiatan usaha.

id.question: Bagaimana cara tambah KBLI satu Lini Produksi?
id.answer: Penambahan KBLI dilakukan melalui perubahan data usaha di OSS dengan memilih KBLI yang relevan dengan lini produksi yang sama.

id.question: Apakah perluasan bisa dilakukan di semua KBLI?
id.answer: Tidak selalu. Kemungkinan perluasan bergantung pada karakteristik KBLI dan ketentuan sektor usaha terkait.

id.question: Bagaimana cara menerbitkan Izin Komersial/Operasional?
id.answer: Izin diterbitkan melalui OSS setelah pelaku usaha memenuhi seluruh persyaratan dan komitmen yang diwajibkan.

id.question: Bagaimana cara tambah cabang di OSS?
id.answer: Tambahan cabang dapat didaftarkan melalui perubahan data pelaku usaha dan penambahan lokasi kegiatan usaha pada OSS.

id.question: Bagaimana alur permohonan sertifikat halal self declare?
id.answer: Pelaku usaha mengajukan melalui SIHALAL, diverifikasi pendamping proses produk halal, kemudian diterbitkan sertifikat halal apabila memenuhi syarat.

id.question: Bagaimana alur permohonan sertifikat halal reguler?
id.answer: Permohonan diajukan melalui SIHALAL, dilakukan pemeriksaan oleh LPH, penetapan fatwa halal, lalu penerbitan sertifikat halal.

id.question: Apakah perkumpulan wajib memiliki NIB?
id.answer: Perkumpulan yang melakukan kegiatan usaha atau kegiatan yang memerlukan perizinan berusaha perlu memiliki NIB melalui OSS.

en.question: How do you apply for KP3A PMSE Business Licensing?
en.answer: Through OSS, by selecting the appropriate business activity, completing the company data, fulfilling the basic requirements and the requirements specific to the PMSE (Trade Through Electronic Systems) sector, then submitting the business license application according to the risk level.

en.question: How do you issue a KP3A License?
en.answer: The business actor fills in the data on OSS, selects the appropriate KBLI (business classification code), completes the requirements, and obtains the license once all requirements have been fulfilled.

en.question: Can a UD (Trading Business) register on OSS and obtain an NIB?
en.answer: Yes. A Trading Business (UD) can register on OSS as an individual/sole proprietorship business and obtain a Business Identification Number (NIB).

en.question: How do you apply for an MSME partnership?
en.answer: The application is made through the partnership feature on OSS by completing the business data and partnership plan. The business actor accesses the partnership menu on OSS, fills in the partnership profile, and submits the data requested by the system.

en.question: Which KBLI codes are required to partner with MSMEs?
en.answer: The KBLI codes required to partner follow the business sector provisions and the list of business fields that require a partnership under applicable investment regulations.

en.question: What is the Masterlist in the OSS system?
en.answer: The Masterlist is a facility for recording the import of machinery, goods, and materials used to obtain certain customs facilities in accordance with applicable provisions.

en.question: How does an individual apply for an Import Facility?
en.answer: The application is submitted through OSS by completing the investment data and import needs in accordance with applicable requirements.

en.question: How do you apply for a raw material import facility?
en.answer: The business actor applies for the facility through OSS by entering the raw material requirements and the required supporting documents.

en.question: How do you apply for a Tax Holiday?
en.answer: The application is submitted through OSS by meeting the pioneer industry criteria and investment requirements set by the Ministry of Finance.

en.question: How do you apply for an Investment Allowance?
en.answer: The application is made through OSS by completing the investment data and the requirements set to obtain that facility.

en.question: How do you apply for a Tax Allowance?
en.answer: The business actor submits the application through OSS and fulfills the business field requirements and the specified investment value.

en.question: Does every business license require a PB-UMKU?
en.answer: No. A PB-UMKU (Business License to Support Business Activities) is only required for certain business activities or sectors that require it.

en.question: How is a Polygon Map created?
en.answer: A polygon map is created by drawing the coordinate points of the business location on a digital map according to the boundaries of the business activity area.

en.question: How do you extend a PKKPR for a National Strategic Project (PSN)/Assessment?
en.answer: The extension application is submitted through OSS before the validity period ends, by completing the required documents.

en.question: How do you extend a PKKPR under Article 181?
en.answer: The business actor submits the extension through OSS in accordance with Article 181, by attaching the required supporting documents.

en.question: What environmental approvals must a business actor hold to run its business activities?
en.answer: Environmental approvals may take the form of an AMDAL (Environmental Impact Analysis), UKL-UPL (Environmental Management and Monitoring Efforts), or SPPL (Statement of Ability to Manage and Monitor the Environment), depending on the risk level and impact of the business activity.

en.question: What are PBG and SLF, and how do you apply for them?
en.answer: PBG is the Building Construction Approval and SLF is the Certificate of Building Functional Suitability. Applications are submitted through the SIMBG system, which is integrated with OSS.

en.question: How long is a PKKPR valid for?
en.answer: The validity period of a PKKPR follows applicable regulations and may differ depending on the type and characteristics of the business activity.

en.question: What are the criteria for applying for a PKKPR under Article 181?
en.answer: The criteria follow the provisions of Article 181 and generally apply to business activities that already have a basis of land control or certain conditions regulated by the provisions.

en.question: How can a micro and small business (UMK) obtain a KKPR?
en.answer: A UMK can obtain a KKPR through OSS by filling in the business location data and following the spatial-planning confirmation process available in the system.

en.question: What is the meaning of KKPR?
en.answer: KKPR (Kesesuaian Kegiatan Pemanfaatan Ruang) is the Conformity of Spatial Utilization Activity, which states the conformity of the planned business activity with the spatial plan.

en.question: What is included in the Machinery Investment Value?
en.answer: The machinery investment value includes the acquisition cost of machinery and equipment that is used directly in the business activity.

en.question: How do you add a KBLI within the same production line?
en.answer: Adding a KBLI is done by changing the business data on OSS and selecting a KBLI relevant to the same production line.

en.question: Can an expansion be carried out for all KBLI codes?
en.answer: Not always. The possibility of expansion depends on the characteristics of the KBLI and the relevant business sector provisions.

en.question: How do you issue a Commercial/Operational License?
en.answer: The license is issued through OSS after the business actor fulfills all the required requirements and commitments.

en.question: How do you add a branch on OSS?
en.answer: An additional branch can be registered by updating the business actor's data and adding the business activity location on OSS.

en.question: What is the process for applying for a self-declared halal certificate?
en.answer: The business actor applies through SIHALAL, is verified by a Halal Product Process Companion, and the halal certificate is then issued if the requirements are met.

en.question: What is the process for applying for a regular halal certificate?
en.answer: The application is submitted through SIHALAL, an examination is carried out by a Halal Inspection Body (LPH), a halal fatwa is issued, and then the halal certificate is issued.

en.question: Is an association (perkumpulan) required to have an NIB?
en.answer: An association that carries out business activities or activities that require a business license needs to have an NIB (Business Identification Number) through OSS.

zh.question: 如何申请KP3A PMSE经营许可？
zh.answer: 通过OSS办理，选择相应的经营活动，完善公司资料，满足基本要求及与PMSE（电子系统贸易）行业相关的要求，随后根据风险等级提交经营许可申请。

zh.question: 如何签发KP3A许可证？
zh.answer: 经营者在OSS上填写资料，选择相应的KBLI（行业分类代码），完善各项要求，待所有要求均满足后即可获得许可。

zh.question: UD（贸易企业）可以在OSS注册并获取NIB吗？
zh.answer: 可以。贸易企业（UD）可以以个人经营者身份在OSS注册，并获得营业识别号（NIB）。

zh.question: 如何为中小微企业（UMKM）申请合作伙伴关系？
zh.answer: 通过OSS的合作伙伴功能提交申请，需完善经营数据及合作计划。经营者进入OSS的合作伙伴菜单，填写合作简介，并提交系统要求的数据。

zh.question: 哪些KBLI必须与中小微企业（UMKM）合作？
zh.answer: 须与中小微企业合作的KBLI依据相关行业规定及现行投资法规中要求合作的经营领域清单确定。

zh.question: OSS系统中的Masterlist是什么？
zh.answer: Masterlist是用于记录机械、货物和材料进口的一种设施，依据相关规定用于获取特定的海关便利措施。

zh.question: 个人如何申请进口便利措施？
zh.answer: 申请须通过OSS提交，并依据现行要求完善投资资料及进口需求。

zh.question: 如何申请原材料进口便利措施？
zh.answer: 经营者须通过OSS申请该便利措施，填写原材料需求，并附上所需的支持文件。

zh.question: 如何申请免税期（Tax Holiday）？
zh.answer: 申请须通过OSS提交，并须符合财政部规定的先驱产业标准及投资要求。

zh.question: 如何申请投资抵免（Investment Allowance）？
zh.answer: 申请通过OSS办理，须完善投资资料并满足获得该便利措施所规定的要求。

zh.question: 如何申请税收减免（Tax Allowance）？
zh.answer: 经营者须通过OSS提交申请，并满足所规定的经营领域要求及投资金额要求。

zh.question: 所有经营许可都需要PB-UMKU吗？
zh.answer: 不需要。PB-UMKU（支持经营活动的经营许可）仅在特定经营活动或行业有此要求时才需要办理。

zh.question: 如何绘制Polygon（多边形）地图？
zh.answer: 多边形地图的绘制方式是根据经营活动区域的边界，在数字地图上标绘经营地点的坐标点。

zh.question: 如何办理国家战略项目（PSN）/评估类PKKPR的延期？
zh.answer: 延期申请须在有效期届满前通过OSS提交，并须完善所需文件。

zh.question: 如何办理依据第181条的PKKPR延期？
zh.answer: 经营者须依据第181条规定通过OSS提交延期申请，并附上所需的支持文件。

zh.question: 经营者开展经营活动须持有哪些环境批准文件？
zh.answer: 环境批准文件可为环境影响评估（AMDAL）、环境管理与监测措施（UKL-UPL），或环境管理与监测能力声明（SPPL），具体取决于经营活动的风险等级及影响程度。

zh.question: PBG和SLF分别指什么？应如何申请？
zh.answer: PBG是建筑物批准，SLF是使用功能合格证。两者均通过与OSS对接的SIMBG系统提交申请。

zh.question: PKKPR的有效期是多久？
zh.answer: PKKPR的有效期依据现行法规执行，并可能因经营活动的类型及特征不同而有所差异。

zh.question: 申请依据第181条办理PKKPR的标准有哪些？
zh.answer: 相关标准依据第181条规定确定，通常适用于已具备土地使用权基础或符合法规规定的特定条件的经营活动。

zh.question: 微小企业（UMK）经营者如何获取KKPR？
zh.answer: 微小企业可通过OSS填写经营地点数据，并依照系统内提供的空间规划确认流程获取KKPR。

zh.question: KKPR的定义是什么？
zh.answer: KKPR（空间利用活动符合性）是指用以说明计划中的经营活动与空间规划相符合的一项确认。

zh.question: 机械投资价值包括哪些内容？
zh.answer: 机械投资价值包括直接用于经营活动的机械及设备的取得成本。

zh.question: 如何在同一生产线内新增KBLI？
zh.answer: 新增KBLI须通过在OSS变更经营数据，并选择与同一生产线相关的KBLI来完成。

zh.question: 是否所有KBLI都可以进行扩产？
zh.answer: 并非总是可以。能否扩产取决于该KBLI的特性及相关行业规定。

zh.question: 如何签发商业/运营许可证？
zh.answer: 经营者满足所有必要要求及承诺事项后，许可证将通过OSS签发。

zh.question: 如何在OSS新增分支机构？
zh.answer: 新增分支机构可通过变更经营者资料并在OSS中新增经营活动地点来完成登记。

zh.question: 自我声明（self declare）清真认证的申请流程是怎样的？
zh.answer: 经营者通过SIHALAL提交申请，由清真产品加工陪同人员进行核实，符合要求后即签发清真认证。

zh.question: 常规清真认证的申请流程是怎样的？
zh.answer: 申请通过SIHALAL提交，由清真检验机构（LPH）进行检验，经清真教令（fatwa）确认后，随后签发清真认证。

zh.question: 社团组织（perkumpulan）是否必须持有NIB？
zh.answer: 从事经营活动或需要经营许可的活动的社团组织，须通过OSS持有营业识别号（NIB）。
